patterns: APPSC asks one-line Qutb Shahi facts: Malkibharama = Ibrahim, Muhammad Quli allowed English at Machilipatnam (1611), Mahasibs = public morals, land revenue = main income, Tavernier under Abdullah, Kohinoor from Kollur.
Other PSCs ask founders/capitals of the five sultanates, Kitab-i-Nauras (Ibrahim Adil Shah II), Gol Gumbaz dome, Aurangzeb's conquest of Bijapur (1686) and Golconda.
Talikota participants (Berar absent) recur with Group-1 framing.
App MCQs are mostly sound but heavily statement-based with deep administrative terminology (Havaldar, Dabir, Shariat Panch) and a few off-topic patron-matching items from other eras.
